name: truthful-pager-totals
description: When a paged feed must serve an EXACT total (denkhaus/work#1296 pattern): push every SQL-reachable filter into BOTH the page SELECT and its COUNT through one shared WHERE builder so total and page can never drift; walk the full filtered set (batched, with a per-run link cache) only for filters that derive past SQL (e.g. triage over live link states), counting matches and slicing the page from the walk. For forge APIs without a count (GitHub issue LIST), take the count from a count-only search (per_page=1) with identical qualifiers, exposed on the port as a list_with_total default method so existing providers/fakes keep compiling.
